## What I found

- `app-gateway` (class `traefik`, listener `http:8000`, `allowedRoutes:namespaces/from=Same`), `app-route` (`app.example.com`, parent `app-gw`, rule `PathPrefix /app` → svc `app:80`), and `app` (nginx) were all in the `default` namespace.
- The `app` deployment was `1/1` ready.
- No requests through the Gateway returned a response before the fix (confirmed by: `curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/app -H 'Host: app.example.com'` → `Error from server: pods "traefik" not found`, while direct request to the service IP `10.96.170.213/app` returned HTTP 200 and nginx body).

## Cause of failure

The `HTTPRoute` pointed at the Gateway by the wrong name: `parentRefs: [ {name: "app-gw"} ]`, but the actual Gateway is `app-gateway`. The Gateway controller couldn't find the named Gateway, so the route never got programmed.

## Fix

One minimal change to the Route (`app-route`):

```
parentRefs:
  - name: app-gateway
    group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
```

(Hostnames `app.example.com`, Gateway `app-gateway` and listener `http:8000`, backend `app:80`/`/app` were left untouched).

## What I found

- `app-gateway` (class `traefik`, listener `http:8000`, `allowedRoutes:namespaces/from=Same`), `app-route` (`app.example.com`, parent `app-gw`, rule `PathPrefix /app` → svc `app:80`), and `app` (nginx) were all in the `default` namespace.

## Cause of failure

The `HTTPRoute` pointed at the Gateway by the wrong name: `parentRefs: [ {name: "app-gw"} ]`, but the actual Gateway is `app-gateway`. The Gateway controller couldn't find the named Gateway, so the route never got programmed.

## Fix

One minimal change to the Route (`app-route`):

```
parentRefs:
  - name: app-gateway
    group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
```

(Hostnames `app.example.com`, Gateway `app-gateway` and listener `http:8000`, backend `app:80`/`/app` were left untouched).

- Route controller status: `Accepted` / `ResolvedRefs`, `parentRef: Gateway/app-gateway`.

- `kubectl exec ... traefik -- curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/app -H 'Host: app.example.com'` → **200**
- `kubectl exec ... app -- curl http://10.96.170.213/app` → **HTTP 200** (nginx body)
- `deployment/app` replicas: requested `1`, updated `1`, ready `1`, available `1` (no pods restarted, 1/1).
